Hi! I am a final year PhD student at University College London (UCL) in London. My primary research interests are machine learning and exoplanet atmospheres. I am currently working with the upcoming ESA Ariel Space Telescope to finalise data processing pipelines for the mission launch in 2029. Click below to see my recent work or get in touch with me.
